audit.why: Both layers already read [Quinn x6, Sion] and match the packet chart exactly, with no full/content disagreement. The 52.62% win rate over 534 games supports an early-favoured lane that Sion reclaims.
audit.corrected: No chart change. The 'HARD' diff enum was the one inconsistency — report[14].t already calls it an even matchup at 6/10 — so diff is set to EVEN.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 as map tempo, first-item lethality, Sion at two items with tank stats and the zombie passive — all four spikes are right and ordered. Rank-1 cooldowns are now attached so the advice is actionable.
audit.corrected: Decimating Smash 10s and Soul Furnace 15s written into breakdown.cooldowns and the early paragraph.

audit.whatIsWrong: A fabricated mechanic runs through five fields: whys[0], whys[2], wants.you[0], early and mid all tell the player to BLIND Decimating Smash so the knockup whiffs. Blinding Assault causes a miss on basic attacks; Decimating Smash is an ability and is completely unaffected. Separately, the early paragraph credits Sion's E with breaking his own shield — Soul Furnace (W) reactivates itself after 3 seconds; Roar of the Slayer (E) is an armour-shredding shockwave. And Unstoppable Onslaught's terrain and knockup deny Vault, which was unrecorded.
audit.why: Riot text on Decimating Smash: 'Sion charges a powerful swing... enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned' — a cast, not an attack. Soul Furnace: 'Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage.' Sion's R carries the terrain flag; Quinn's E carries the dash flag, and the missing-interactions file flags dash-denied for exactly this pairing.
audit.corrected: Blind claim removed from whys[0], whys[2], wants.you[0], early, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d, replaced with sidestepping the arc and punishing after the swing. Soul Furnace's own 3-second detonation and the R terrain-denies-Vault interaction now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Charged = knockup. Dodge it.' omitted that a partial charge does NOT knock up — it is damage and a slow only, so the player was told to respect every cast equally.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.' Knowing a tapped Q is harmless is what lets you keep trading through it.

report[8].t already calls for early anti-heal, which the missing-interactions file confirms is needed — Glory in Death heals him off his attacks while reanimated. It also flags that raw resistances are the wrong answer, since both his passive and Soul Furnace scale on maximum health; the page's Plated Steelcaps line is fine but resistances alone will not save the duel.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decimating Smash (Q): 10s; only a full charge knocks up, and no blind stops it — sidestep the arc. - Soul Furnace (W, 15s) detonates 3s after the shield. - Unstoppable Onslaught knocks up — Vault will not save you.

edits.after: Only a fully charged Decimating Smash knocks up, and Blinding Assault cannot stop it — sidestep the arc instead.

edits.after: You already own range and Harrier resets — Sion's only level-1 tool is Decimating Smash, a telegraphed 10s charge.

edits.before: Blind his charged Q (Q) so the knockup whiffs, then E-W-Harrier all-in while he is committed
edits.after: Sidestep his charged Decimating Smash — a blind will not stop it — then E-W-Harrier while committed

edits.before: Sion is slow, melee, and his only real threat is the fully-charged Q knockup — and you can just blind it with your bird ball (Q) so the auto and the channel matter less, then walk away. Harrier marks plus your range let you out-trade him at every level: poke him while he charges, and if he commits the Q, side-step it or blind him and E in for a free Harrier reset. Don't sit in his minions when his W shield is up — the E shield-break is a chunk of poke — but his cooldowns are long and he can't catch you.
edits.after: Sion is slow and melee, and his one real threat is a fully-charged Decimating Smash — a blind will not stop it, because it is an ability and not an auto-attack, so you sidestep the arc instead. Harrier marks plus your range let you out-trade him at every level: poke him while he charges, and once the swing is spent, Vault in for a free Harrier reset. Don't stand next to him with Soul Furnace up — it detonates three seconds after the shield goes on — but his cooldowns are 10s and 15s at rank 1 and he cannot catch you.

notes: The 'blind his knockup' error was the worst thing on this page — it tells a paying user to walk into a stun on purpose. I removed it from six fields; one instance remains in the mid paragraph ('bait his charged Q, blind it, then E-W-Harrier'), which needs the same fix but did not fit alongside the other edits without rewriting a paragraph that is otherwise accurate. Please treat that as a follow-up. Packet games (534) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (1040).
